summary.headline: Preface to the Calendar Commentary
summary.text: Muzaffar Munajjim Junabadi explains his Persian commentary on a concise treatise on the complete calendar by Nizam al-Din 'Abd al-'Ali Birjandi. He describes defining technical terms and incorporating necessary material from astronomy and geometry while referring detailed proofs to foundational works.
